utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — book club is Thursday at 7:00 PM at my place, 14 Maple Street, and you’re very welcome to come. If getting there is tricky, I can help you figure it out.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll probably be a little late, but I can bring dessert.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s perfect, Dane — dessert is always welcome, and just come whenever you can make it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds fine to me—same book, next Thursday evening at your place. Just let me know the time and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, great — I’ll keep an ear out for any updates and let you know what I hear. Thanks, Eli!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Nell — I appreciate it. Just let me know the time when you hear back, and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, I can do book club as long as it doesn’t land on school pickup day. If it works, I’m happy to host and people can bring snacks.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, so is it actually happening on school-pickup day or not? And can you confirm the time for Faye’s place once it’s set?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I haven’t confirmed the day yet—if it falls on school pickup day, I’ll need to pass. Once we set it, I’ll send the time for my place.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure thing, I’ll keep an ear out and let you know what the book club decides.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, thanks, Noah. I’ve still got the snacks and extra tea ready, so just let me know if the group needs anything else.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Cleo — I’ll let you know if I hear anything from the group.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That should work, but I’ll need the exact time and address so I can plan ahead.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll check with the book club and let you know the exact time and address.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Vik — I’ll wait for the details so I can plan my evening.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, book club? I heard we’re picking a new read soon, and I’m hoping it’s something juicy.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me which book club details you want me to check first?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: The room and time would be great—then we’ll know where to show up. And if you hear the new book too, that’d be a bonus!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Are we still meeting at your place for book club, and should I bring snacks?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’m still checking the room and time for book club, so I can’t confirm my place yet. I’ll let you know as soon as I’ve got the details, and snacks would be great if we do meet there.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks — just let me know when you confirm the room and time. If it’s at your place, I’ll bring snacks.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—just let me know when you hear back from Mara. What are they reading this time?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: We’ve got a little mix right now—a mystery, a memoir, and a novel someone keeps passing around. I can bring the full list next time if you want.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, just bring the full list next time. I’ll take a quick look then.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It’s now Thursday at the cafe, not Tuesday at the library.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, got it — Thursday at the cafe works better. I’ll help line up a time and keep school pickup day in mind.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Jules — I’ll keep the Thursday cafe time in mind and make sure it doesn’t clash with school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: We’re still deciding the new read, but I’ll send the time once it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Leo — just send the time when it’s set, and I’ll share the Thursday cafe details too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I’ll send the time as soon as it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rey. Thursday at the cafe works better for me — please keep me posted.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I’ll keep you posted. And I’d love to hear what the book club is reading lately.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’m not sure yet, but I’ll let you know when I hear.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard it’s a mystery novel this week—pretty sure everyone’s excited about it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds like a good one—if the book club needs anything, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’s really kind of you, Gus — I’ll pass that along if they need anything. I’m looking forward to hearing what everyone thinks of the mystery.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good—happy to help with setup if you need it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Gus — I’ll check with the book club and let you know what we decide.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Vik — just let me know if you need any tools or a hand with setup.

utterances.speaker: Rey

utterances.speaker: Hana

utterances.speaker: Rey

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: We’re still deciding the next read, and Thursday time isn’t set yet. I’ll let you know as soon as it’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good, Leo — just let me know when Thursday’s confirmed, and I can help narrow down the next read.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Will do — I’ll send the Thursday time and the read once they’re set.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Dane — what’s the book club reading this time?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a bit behind, so I’ll check with the group and get back to you on the book, Sam.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: No worries, Dane — just let me know when you’ve got it, and I’ll keep an eye out for the details.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Kira — could you check which mystery novel Oren’s leaning toward first? Then I can help pin down a time that works for everyone, especially around school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So is Oren actually leaning toward one yet, or is that still up in the air? And what time are we talking for next Thursday?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s still a bit up in the air — if you can ask Oren which mystery he’s closest to, I’ll see what Thursday time works best around school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, a new novel sounds right. What’s the title?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll check the updated book club details — it’s Thursday at the cafe now, so I’ll confirm the exact time too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thursday at the cafe works for me — what time is it?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, book club? I heard we’re picking a new read soon, and I’m hoping it’s something juicy.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve only heard bits and pieces, but I’d love to know what the book club is reading next.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll find out for sure and tell you—I’m curious too, especially if it’s a good page-turner.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Are we still meeting at your place for book club, and should I bring snacks?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I think so — Thursday at 7 at Quinn’s place on Maple Street. I can ask around about snacks or the book when I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — I’ll bring the full list, and let’s meet at Quinn’s place on Maple Street Thursday at 7.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — book club is Thursday at 7:00 PM at my place, 14 Maple Street, and you’re very welcome to come. If getting there is tricky, I can help you figure it out.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, thanks — Thursday at 7:00 at your place works for me. I’ll see you there, and I appreciate the offer if I need help getting over.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Wonderful, Oren — I’m glad you can make it! See you Thursday at 7, and just give me a shout if anything comes up.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Of course, Uli — no pressure at all, and I’ll keep you posted about Thursday at the cafe.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. I appreciate it — I’ll let you know if I can make Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Sounds good, Uli — just let me know whenever you can. Hope to see you Thursday at the cafe!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, book club still works for me as long as it’s not on school pickup day. If you’re bringing snacks, that would be great.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works for me—next Thursday evening sounds fine. I’d just like the exact time and your address so I can put it on my calendar.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Next Thursday at 7 works for me, and I’ll send you the address. Thanks for checking in — that should be easy to fit around pickup.
